title: StorONE Unleashes Ninefold Storage Boost for Existing All-Flash Arrays, No New Hardware Required
summary: StorONE's new Version 4.0 software introduces a groundbreaking Real-Time Tiering architecture, allowing businesses to multiply the effective storage capacity of their existing All-Flash Arrays by up to nine times. This innovation promises significant cost savings and efficiency gains by maximizing current infrastructure without the need for additional hardware purchases.
content:
In an era defined by explosive data growth and persistent budget constraints, enterprises constantly grapple with the escalating cost and complexity of storage. Just when it seems the only answer is to buy more, StorONE has stepped in with a refreshing solution that could fundamentally alter how businesses manage their high-performance data.

The New York-based storage innovator today announced StorONE Version 4.0, featuring a revolutionary Real-Time Tiering architecture. This isn't merely an incremental update; it's a paradigm shift designed to wring unprecedented value out of existing infrastructure. Specifically, StorONE 4.0 enables businesses to immediately supercharge their current third-party All-Flash Arrays (AFAs), delivering up to nine times more effective storage capacity without purchasing a single new flash drive.

The magic lies in its intelligent tiering system, which dynamically moves data between different storage tiers based on real-time access patterns. This ensures frequently accessed, critical data resides on the fastest flash, while less active data is efficiently managed, all within the existing AFA footprint. The result? Extended life cycles for costly hardware, massive capital expenditure savings on new flash purchases, and a notable reduction in operational complexity.

For IT managers and CFOs alike, this translates into a powerful win. Not only does it defer expensive hardware upgrades, but it also improves storage utilization, performance, and significantly reduces the environmental footprint associated with manufacturing and powering new devices. StorONE 4.0 isn't just about saving money; it’s about optimizing resources, making existing investments work harder, and smarter, in a storage landscape that demands nothing less.
keyTakeaways: StorONE Version 4.0 allows existing All-Flash Arrays (AFAs) to deliver up to 9x more effective storage.
The innovation leverages a new Real-Time Tiering architecture, eliminating the need to purchase additional flash hardware.
This solution provides significant cost savings, extends hardware lifespans, and enhances storage efficiency and sustainability for businesses.
author: StorONE

title: Fiverr's Q2 Report Looms: What It Means for the Future of Work
summary: Fiverr International Ltd. is slated to release its second-quarter 2026 financial results on July 29, 2026, offering crucial insights into the performance of a key player in the evolving gig economy. Investors and analysts will scrutinize these figures for indicators of freelance market health, user growth, and the company's strategic trajectory.
content:
New York is abuzz as Fiverr International Ltd. (NYSE: FVRR), a pivotal force in reshaping how the world collaborates and earns, announced it would unveil its second-quarter financial results for the period ending June 30, 2026. The highly anticipated report is scheduled for release after market close on Wednesday, July 29, 2026, promising to be a significant moment for the digital freelance marketplace and the broader gig economy.

These upcoming results aren't just a routine financial update; they serve as a critical barometer for the health and trajectory of the increasingly dominant freelance sector. With its vast network connecting businesses to skilled freelancers worldwide, Fiverr’s performance offers a window into global employment trends, digital transformation, and the evolving landscape of professional services. Analysts will be keen to dissect key metrics such as user acquisition, gross merchandise value (GMV), take rate, and overall profitability, seeking clues about sustained growth amidst fluctuating economic conditions.

The company has also detailed plans for a live conference call and webcast to discuss the results. This session, scheduled for 8:30 a.m. ET on July 30, 2026, will feature management insights and a Q&A segment, providing further clarity on Fiverr's strategic initiatives and outlook. Interested parties can access the webcast on the investor relations section of Fiverr’s website, ensuring transparency for shareholders and market observers.

As the world continues to embrace flexible work models and digital-first operations, Fiverr’s financial disclosures will undoubtedly influence investor sentiment and paint a clearer picture of the resilience and potential of the freelance economy. All eyes will be on July 29th for what promises to be a revealing look at the company’s recent performance and its vision for the future of work.
keyTakeaways: Fiverr International Ltd. will release its second-quarter 2026 financial results on July 29, 2026, after market close.
The report is expected to provide key insights into the health of the gig economy, Fiverr's user growth, and overall financial performance.
A conference call and live webcast for investors and analysts will follow on July 30, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET.
author: Fiverr International Ltd.
